The idea here is to take the concept of a subverse and use it in a new way. Users submit links to streaming content like videos or music. Users can comment and vote on these as usual.

What is new is that the top half of the webpage would be a live media player that streams content from youtube, soundcloud, twitch etc. based on a playlist. Viewers can interact with one another via subverse chat and queue up videos/music in the playlist and others can vote on what has been queued to play.

When nobody is queuing up content from the subverse's library, the existing submissions play on a rotation based on popularity and how recent they were submitted.

This would enable users to experience videos and music together and comment on them in real time. Users/mods could curate our own streaming TV and Radio stations, have MST3K style movie nights, Saturday morning cartoons etc.

I know some parts of this have already been done on various other sites, but I think the combination could be a powerful new way to share and experience streaming content together and as a bonus, voat would not have to deal with hosting that content.

I have more details of how this would work if anyone is interested in discussing it further.

Some sites that do some aspects of this already:

http://cytu.be/ allows users to create channels and watch youtube videos in sync, along with text chat. It also has the playlist mechanic I mentioned.

https://plug.dj/ allows a DJ to queue up videos from youtube and soundcloud while others can chat and watch/listen in sync.

http://twitch.tv/ does many aspects of this for live streaming.

http://soundcloud.com/ does not allow synchronization, but it has a really neat live annotation mechanic that lets users create pop up comments on specific points in a song. This would be neat for videos too, as long as users can choose to ignore anyone they find annoying.
